I joined pole dance training for the first time last month, something I had been wanting to do since 2022, and I’m so glad I finally did. Both the coaches, Ravi and Rashmi, are incredibly supportive and genuinely wonderful people. Ravi, especially, motivated me to push through moments when I felt like giving up, and his coaching made a huge difference in my progress.
The studio itself is cosy, comfortable, and has a very welcoming vibe, which made every session enjoyable. One of the highlights of my experience was being part of Beyond Addiction 2, a pole dance showcase event. Performing in front of an audience for the first time was truly surreal and unforgettable.
I’m really grateful to both of them for such an amazing experience. Couldn’t have asked for a better start to my pole dance journey.

featured_reviews.name: komal sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: My pole dance journey has been incredible since I started training at Raashvi Dance under Ravi’s guidance. He’s extremely patient, knowledgeable, and creates a really supportive learning environment. The studio itself is lovely, and I genuinely enjoy every session here. I’d definitely recommend Raashvi Dance to anyone looking to begin their pole journey!

featured_reviews.name: Ramya Seshadri
featured_reviews.review_text:
As someone deeply connected to movement, pole dancing had been something I’d wanted to explore for a long time—both for its beauty and for the incredible strength, body awareness, and coordination it requires. I was so happy to find Rashmi and Ravi.

As a teacher myself, learning environment matters a lot to me. Rashmi and Ravi strike a wonderful balance of being warm, encouraging, and technically sound. Their guidance feels supportive without pressure, and clear without being rigid, which makes learning feel both safe and exciting.

I’m already enjoying the growth I’m experiencing and truly look forward to continuing this journey with them for as long as I can. Highly recommend their classes to anyone wanting to explore pole with strong foundations and thoughtful teaching!

featured_reviews.name: Mahek Shivnani
featured_reviews.review_text:
What started as a one-time workshop quickly became something I truly look forward to. I attended my first-ever pole dance workshop at Raashvidance at the start of 2025 and had such a good time that joining regular classes with them felt like an easy decision.

Ravi and Rashmi are incredibly warm, encouraging, and flexible, and they make every session feel fun, and empowering while still being a great workout and teaching technical skills. They’ve created a space where pole dancing feels joyful and completely destigmatised.

A few months in, I’m so glad I took that first step. Highly recommend Raashvidance! ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Pearlene Sarosh
featured_reviews.review_text: Ravi is challenging, structured, and genuinely empowering. The classes focus on proper technique, strength, flexibility, and control—not just tricks for the sake of it. Ravi explains movements clearly, corrects form patiently, and pushes you to progress without risking injury. You leave every class feeling stronger, more confident, and actually proud of what your body can do. Highly recommend if you want real skill-building, not shortcuts.

featured_reviews.name: Suhani Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm absolutely loving my pole dance classes at Raashvi! The instructors, Ravi and Rashmi, are amazing - super experienced, supportive, and patient. They make you feel so comfortable, even in a group class, it's like having a personal session 😊. The training is top-notch, and they've become like family away from home. I feel incredibly strong after each class and genuinely look forward to every session. What sets them apart is their continued guidance for staying fit and healthy - it's a complete and empowering experience! Whether you're a beginner or advanced, this is the place to learn, grow, and challenge yourself. Highly recommend! 💪

featured_reviews.review_text:
Heartfelt Review for Bhavana Miss – Sanskar Activity Classes

Enrolling my son in Sanskar Activity Classes has been one of the best decisions we've made. It’s a beautiful blend of dance, shloka, and aasana – nurturing both creativity and cultural values in children.

But what truly makes this class extraordinary is Bhavana Miss. She is not just a dance teacher – she is an inspiration, a guide, and a second mother to every child. Her choreography is simply magical, her teaching style is loving yet disciplined, and her dedication is unmatched. Kids adore her, and parents trust her completely.

Under her guidance, I’ve seen a remarkable change in my son – not just in dance, but in confidence, expression, and discipline. Her energy lights up the room, and her passion reflects in every performance.

I feel truly blessed and proud that my son is learning from someone as talented and genuine as Bhavana Miss. I strongly recommend every parent to let their child experience this beautiful journey under her care.

Miss Bhavana – you are the best, and we are so lucky to have you! 🌟
